program.title: Create a qualified opportunity
program.objectiveText:
I want account executives to create a properly qualified opportunity in this system from an inbound lead.

A properly qualified opportunity must have:
1. A named decision-maker contact
2. Budget status confirmed (Approved or Allocated)
3. A decision timeline (not Unknown)
4. Competitors recorded, or "None identified"
5. A next step scheduled within 14 days

Reps must not paste customer contract terms into free-text notes. Success is every new opportunity meeting all five requirements.

workflow.title: Create a qualified opportunity

steps.title: Open the lead record
steps.modeRationale: Navigation carries no judgment; Synforma can perform it or the person can.

steps.title: Start the opportunity from the lead
steps.description: Open menu Actions, then Actions → Convert to opportunity
steps.modeRationale: Opening the form is mechanical. In Guide mode the person is shown where it is.

steps.title: Basics
steps.modeRationale: Values can be derived from the record and defaults; the person reviews before moving on.
steps.expected: Next leads to the next step.

steps.title: Qualification
steps.modeRationale: Requirements 1, 2 need human knowledge (who decides, what is funded). Synforma guides and never guesses.
steps.expected: Next leads to the next step.

steps.title: Review and create
steps.description: Review the values, acknowledge "Data quality reminder" and create opportunity.
steps.modeRationale: The commit only confirms values already decided; it is approval-gated and audited.

successCriteria: A next step scheduled within 14 days
